newsitem.title: USA: Life Medical says REPEL-CV trials effective.
newsitem.headline: Life Medical says REPEL-CV trials effective.

text.p: Life Medical Sciences Inc said on Thursday that its REPEL-CV product had effectively reduced scarring in pre-clinical trials in cardiovascular surgical procedures.
The study, conducted on animals, "demonstrated a dramatic reduction in the extent of adhesions" when the product was used, the biotechnology company said.

"Based on the positive results from these pre-clinical studies, we are in discussion with the FDA regarding an investigation device exemption in preparation for initiating U.S. clinical trials in cardiovascular surgery later this year," said Eli Pines, the company's vice president and chief scientific officer.

REPEL-CV is the latest in a series of adhesion prevention products that use the company's proprietary bioresorbable polymer technology, Life Medical Sciences said in a statement. At present, there are no U.S. Food and Drug Administration-approved bioresorbable adhesion prevention products available for use in cardiovascular surgery, the company added.
